questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 16 cm and a height of 10 cm. Take your time: what is its area?

block.label: Quick Recall
block.sub: Four options, one answer — keep it fast

questions.why: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 16 × 10 = 80 cm² — don't skip the halving step.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. What is its total surface area? (use π ≈ 3.14, round to 1 decimal place)

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Total surface area = 2πr² + 2πrh = 2(3.14)(16) + 2(3.14)(4)(10) = 100.5 + 251.2 = 351.7 cm². Forgetting the two circular ends gives the wrong smaller totals.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a closed container, 40g of reactants react fully. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: Mass is conserved in a closed system, so the total mass of products equals the total mass of reactants: 40g.

questions.subject: Science
